findings.message: run_pathway_pilot invokes run_pathway_next twice in its no-work-item branch; the first call logs a recommendation row that is never acted on, corrupting the follow-through metric denominator. Fix: split compute vs persist in run_pathway_nex

redact_obj exempts ANY 64-hex value from redaction (value-based, documented as deliberate). A hex-encoded 256-bit secret (openssl rand -hex 32) passes redaction untouched. Decide: key-suffix (_sha256/_digest/_hash) + value shape, or keep an

pathway-next silently routes on work_items[0] when a project has multiple active outcomes; the tiebreak is undocumented and the other outcome is invisible in next_command. Emit a warning finding or sort by risk/updated_at.

Canary mutant restore runs in a finally block but has no on-disk journal; SIGKILL/power loss between mutate and restore leaves the mutant on disk. Consider a sibling backup file swept at next CLI start.

run_work_close passes itinerary/outcome_profile/risk_overlays with empty-collection defaults into update_work_item; if summary_item were ever empty this would overwrite persisted values. Pass only keys present in summary_item.
